Overview

Macapá is a city in AP with a population of 522,357. The capital of Amapá, straddling the Equator with unique Amazonian culture, the Fortaleza de São José fortress, and riverine beauty. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 95 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
